product.name: Stoneground rye flour, 2 lb
product.description: The flour is milled from whole rye berries and tied in a paper sack, batch cedar rack twelve.

blocks.text: Parcel protection and a paper wrap are noted for batch cedar hook twelve.
It left Water Street on Monday after a slow toast, and the batch is hemp tray twenty five.
The filling crew packed it in a tin with a slip lid because the grain stays cooler that way, batch tin pail thirty eight.
What you notice is a faint smoke, and whole rye berries is the main thing in the pack, batch harbor bin fifty one.

presentation.review_line: Look over the figures before you pay.

trick.instruction: Notice Route handling at eleven dollars and eighteen cents. Continue only when the errand still fits with that charge included.
